text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait will complete repayment this week of a $5.5 billion international loan that helped finance reconstruction after the Gulf War.

- A public issue, offering 500,000 dinars worth of shares in the Bahrain Islamic Insurance Company is to open on Thursday. Five million shares, priced at 150 fils each, will be available to the public through the issue.
- Bahraini housing minister to open Lulu Centre in Manama on Wednesday. The building of the commercial centre cost 1.5 million dinars.
